authorization.basis: Owner ruling 2026-09-17: all Lane E experiment runs authorized provided each run is logged as a receipt; roster set by owner (Luna unavailable; Gemini 3.8 Flash high).

exposure.method: Treatment body delivered byte-identically via --append-system-prompt (summon semantics: one skill body into context). Skill discovery, context files, prompt templates and non-provider extensions disabled in both arms; tool allowlist read,edit,write excludes extension tools.

observed.probePrompt: Reply with exactly the word OK.
observed.interpretation: Delta (~bytes/4) is consistent with the full body in the system prompt and absent from control. pi session logs do not persist the system prompt, so this token delta is the hard signal.

planned.cwd: fresh mktemp task root containing only installability.ts

harnessEnvironment.observed: per-run record.json (model_change event in session log)
harnessEnvironment.costSource: canonical skill-cost from actual pi session logs; lane total reported at close

futureDesign.primaryOutcome: Per arm: evaluator exit code (0 = all 13 checks pass) and the set of failed check ids. Reported per replication pair; no pooled effect size, no significance test (n=2 pairs).
secondaryOutcomes: task root contains only installability.ts after the run
turn count and token usage (descriptive only)
futureDesign.runner: runner/arm.sh (central-held; argv printed in a visible herdr pane); runs refuse to overwrite an existing run id
interpretationLimits: one historically exposed case; the model may have seen the public fix
n=2 pairs cannot establish a general effect
a null or mixed result is recorded as such
evaluator sandboxing is not enforced; the agent's tools can read absolute paths

limitations: evaluator not sandboxed from the agent's read tool

variants.status: run; results in results/results.json (confounded by output-cap termination in 3/4 arms)

variants.rationale: v1 was dominated by single-turn output-cap termination (stopReason=length) independent of treatment. v2 repeats the identical design, exposure method, prompt, task, evaluator and order with EFFORT=medium to reduce that confound. It is a separate experiment, not a re-run or retry of v1; v1 results stand as recorded.
variants.exposureProbe: required: v2 probe control/treatment before arms
variants.primaryOutcome: same as v1; additionally report finalStopReason per arm
variants.stoppingRule: run exactly these 4 arms; no further variants without a new preregistration commit

variants.harnessMode: interactive pi via the pi-zero door (Skill Heaven main 358be74), each arm in its own visible herdr pane at the owner's request

arms.treatment: pi-zero --level low --skill <treatment dir> (native skill listing; body read on demand)

variants.symmetryNote: pi-zero --level low omits --no-context-files/--no-prompt-templates that --level zero sets; v3 passes both to both arms. Recorded as a door finding.
variants.prompt: task/prompt.md whitespace-flattened to one line (sha256 recorded per run) so it submits as a single interactive message
variants.concurrency: control and treatment of a pair start simultaneously in two panes; pairs run sequentially
variants.completion: an arm is finished when the pane agent is idle for 20s after having worked
variants.exposureSignal: treatment: native listing present (first-turn input token delta vs control) and whether the session contains a read of the treatment SKILL.md; no read is recorded as listed-but-not-loaded, not as exposure
variants.primaryOutcome: same as v1/v2 plus finalStopReason and treatment bodyReadInSession
variants.stoppingRule: exactly 2 pairs; no retries; no further variants without a new preregistration commit
variants.infrastructureAbortRule: A pair interrupted by provider quota or authentication failure (no model-ended turn, no evaluation) is rerun in full from fresh task roots; the aborted attempt is kept under runs/aborted-quota. Model-ended attempts (stop/length) are outcomes and are never rerun. Added after v3 pair 2 attempt 1 hit the Antigravity quota and before any pair 2 outcome existed.
